label.description: The name of the Stepper region, rendered as the heading in the summary bar.

headingId.description: The id of the heading, which names the region.

listId.description: The id of the step list, which the toggle controls.

elements.name: signature

properties.description: The name of the step, always visible.
Where the step is in the flow; at most one step can be `current`.
Supporting detail under the title; on an error step it is the error text.

steps.description: The steps of the flow in order.

stepCountLabel.description: Returns the position text of the named step.

toggleLabel.description: The visually hidden suffix of the toggle's name.

themeOverride.description: The theme override of the Stepper, which owns the mobile tokens.

children.description: The step items of the list.
